name: Longchengornis
sum: Small enantiornithean from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, about 120 million years old.
wsnote: About 11 cm long and 7.5 cm at the hip, from the holotype (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: IVPP V10530, a partly articulated skeleton and partial skull.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Hou 1997

sources.text: Hou, Lianhou 1997. Mesozoic Birds of China. Phoenix Valley Provincial Aviary of Taiwan.
